setIndex.coverageNote: A day is published only when at least 80% of this set's priceable cards were priced that day. Days below that are absent from the series — never interpolated. Every total is a FLOOR over the cards that were actually priced, not a complete set price.

trendRule:
A move is judged against the series' own volatility, never against a fixed percentage.
  expected_move = max(volatility_annualised, 0.05) * sqrt(window_days / 365)
      -- one standard deviation of movement for THIS series over THIS window.
  z = change_frac / expected_move
  flat  when |change_frac| < 2% or |z| < 1.0
  up    when z >=  threshold
  down  when z <= -threshold
The 5% volatility floor stops a series that has never moved from turning a rounding blip into an infinite z-score; the 2% absolute floor stops a cent of movement on a cheap card from being called a trend. Consequence, and the point of the rule: a 5% move over 30 days is 'flat' on a card that swings 60% annualised (z=0.3) and 'up' on one that swings 5% (z=3.5).

vintageBoundary.note: Vintage is not an official designation. This deployment treats Black & White and earlier as vintage, broader than the common WotC-only or through-EX conventions.
